free_tier.stated: Community plan, $0 per month: public relays in US, EU and Singapore, rate-limited traffic, no uptime guarantees, no auth; the rate limit is not published

egress.terms: Public relays are rate-limited per connection with no published limit; the pricing page lists egress and rate limit as 'Variable'. Paid routes: Pro $19/month has a 5 MB/s rate limit and 100 GB egress then $0.09/GB; Dedicated adds $199/month per region with no rate limits and 250 GB egress then $0.09/GB.

reliability_note: Free public relays: rate-limited traffic with an unpublished limit, no uptime guarantees, development and hobby use only; no published limit supports 1 TiB a day. The paid Dedicated route has no rate limit and bills $0.09/GB beyond 250 GB.
confidence_note: documented from vendor pages read on 2026-11-03: the plan rates and egress (https://www.iroh.computer/pricing), and the rate limiting and hobby-use statements (https://docs.iroh.computer/iroh-services/relays/public and https://docs.iroh.computer/relays/rate-limiting). Identity, retention and per-object cap were not read.
